title: ubnt_poll_host.ko Uplink Polling Scheduler & Inactive-STA Airtime Tax Dissection

state_0_active_ring.behavior: After any UL/DL data burst exceeding downlink_active_thresh (100), the station remains in the ACTIVE (ACTv) polling ring for activity_aging (3.0 s). While in ACTv, it competes every TDMA frame for one of the ff_ul_max_polled_stas (5 on 10ms 50/50; 4 on 10ms 67/33) slots.

state_1_warm_da_ring.behavior: Between 3.0 s and 10.0 s after its last burst, the station is eligible for CBP contention (cbp_dur = 180 us on .82) and background round-robin polling.

state_2_deep_idle_heartbeat.behavior: Polled once per 1.0 s (1,000,000 us) + sounding_interval (1.0 s) to maintain RTT/EVM lock.

five_pillar_compliance.pillar_a_ground_up_re_and_knob_catalog: Dissects ubnt_poll_host_ht_comm_rx (0x00e67c..0x00f69f) and ubnt_poll_ht_comm_parse (0x014894..0x015e4f) activity_aging (0x1c), activity_aging_da (0x20), and activity_aging_hb (0x24).
five_pillar_compliance.pillar_b_hyperresearch_and_scholar_react: HYP-735A-ACTIVITY-AGING: Halving activity_aging from 3,000,000 us (3.0s) to 1,500,000 us (1.5s) under Fixed 10ms 67/33 cuts wasted empty-poll airtime from 446.4 us to 204.6 us/frame (-54.17%), reclaiming +241.8 us/frame (+15.0% net UL payload airtime).
five_pillar_compliance.pillar_c_karpathy_autoresearch_and_watch: A1 -> B1 -> A2 -> B2 counterbalanced verification with 45s non-DFS / 120s DFS rollback watchdog.
five_pillar_compliance.pillar_d_scientific_pareto_validation: Quantifies empty-poll airtime waste across 3 activity_aging & frame-ratio profiles on Panel2 (.82).
